cases.name: incomparable inbound choices fail without running a body

steps.source: let log="";class C{operator C(v:number){log+="n";return new C();} operator C(v:string){log+="s";return new C();}}const x:any=3;try{const c:C=x;log+="/"+String(c instanceof C);}catch(e){log+="/"+e.name;}log;

cases.name: source does not beat constructor

steps.source: let log="";class C{constructor(v:any){log+="c";}}class S{operator C(){log+="s";return new C(0);}}const raw:any=new S();const c:C=raw;log;

cases.name: inapplicable constructor permits inbound

steps.source: let log="";class C{constructor(v:boolean){log+="c";}operator C(v:number){log+="i";return new C(true);}}const raw:any=1;try{const c:C=raw;}catch(e){log+="/"+e.name;}log;

steps.source: let log="";class C{constructor(v:any){log+="c";return {};}}const raw:any=1;try{const c:C=raw;log+="/"+String(c instanceof C);}catch(e){log+="/"+e.name;}log;

cases.name: wrong source result

steps.source: let log="";class C{}class S{operator C(){log+="s";const result:any={};return result;}}const raw:any=new S();try{const c:C=raw;log+="/"+String(c instanceof C);}catch(e){log+="/"+e.name;}log;

cases.name: source same name wrong identity

steps.source: let log="";class C{}const Outer=C;class S{operator C(){log+="s";return new C();}}{class C{}const raw:any=new S();try{const c:C=raw;log+="/"+String(c instanceof C);}catch(e){log+="/"+e.name;}}log;

steps.source: let log="";class C{operator C(v:boolean){log+="b";return new C();}operator C(v:any){log+="a";return new C();}}const raw:any=true;const c:C=raw;log+"/"+String(c instanceof C);

cases.name: untyped inbound loses to specific declaration

steps.source: let log="";class C{operator C(v:boolean){log+="b";return new C();}operator C(v){log+="a";return new C();}}const raw:any=true;const c:C=raw;log;

cases.name: already member bypasses self source conversion

steps.source: let log="";class C{operator C(){log+="s";return this;}}const raw:any=new C();const c:C=raw;log+"/"+String(c===raw);

cases.name: inbound parameter numeric conversion remains checked

steps.source: let log="";class C{operator C(v:uint8){log+=String(v is uint8);return new C();}}const raw:any=7;const c:C=raw;log+"/"+String(c instanceof C);

cases.name: explicit target keeps inbound parameter range check

steps.source: let calls=0;class C{operator C(v:uint8){calls++;return new C();}}const raw:any=257;let e="";try{const c=raw:=C;}catch(err){e=err.name;}e+"/"+calls;

cases.name: pure rejected parameter does not preempt viable alternative

steps.source: let log="";class C{operator C(v:string){log+="s";return new C();}operator C(v:uint8){log+="n";return new C();}}const raw:any=257;const c:C=raw;log;

cases.name: inbound aliases retain declaration scope

steps.source: let log="";type P=uint8;class C{operator C(v:P){log+=String(v is uint8);return new C();}}function go(){type P=boolean;const raw:any=7;const c:C=raw;return String(c instanceof C);}const answer=go();log+"/"+answer;

cases.name: inherited source target set is preserved

steps.source: let log="";class C{}class D{}class Base{operator C(){log+="b";return new C();}}class Child extends Base{operator D(){log+="d";return new D();}}const raw:any=new Child();const c:C=raw;log;

steps.source: let log="";class C{}class Base{operator C(){log+="b";return new C();}}class Child extends Base{operator C(){log+="c";return new C();}}const raw:any=new Child();const c:C=raw;log;

cases.name: selected result keeps exact prototype obligation

steps.source: class C{operator C(v:any){return new C();}}const raw:any=1;const c:C=raw;String(Reflect.setPrototypeOf(c,null));

cases.name: selected parameter retains obligation after body throw

steps.source: class P{}class C{operator C(v:P){throw new Error("body");}}const raw:any=new P();let e="";try{const c:C=raw;}catch(err){e=err.name;}e+"/"+String(Reflect.setPrototypeOf(raw,null));

cases.name: unselected inbound parameter acquires no obligation

steps.source: class P{}class C{operator C(v:P){throw new Error("unused");}}class S extends P{operator C(){return new C();}}const raw:any=new S();const c:C=raw;String(Reflect.setPrototypeOf(raw,null))+"/"+String(c instanceof C);

cases.name: failed conversion leaves prior assignment intact

steps.source: class C{operator C(v:boolean){throw new Error("selected");}operator C(v:any){return new C();}}let held:C=new C();const original=held;const raw:any=true;let e="";try{held=raw;}catch(err){e=err.message;}e+"/"+String(held===original);

steps.source: let log="";class C{operator C(v:boolean){log+="b";return new C();}operator C(v:any){log+="a";return new C();}}const raw:any=true;function f(v:C){return v;}const c=f(raw);log+"/"+String(c instanceof C);
